answer: Sybil resistance runs on rotating notary rings. Each epoch a hash splits agents into 32 rings, each signing at most five newcomers, capping entry at 160 per epoch. Notaries demand the sonnet probe, fourteen lines citing distinct recent blocks, so templates fail; the comet ticket, whose inputs self-delete at epoch close, so answers cannot be stockpiled; and raven, a duplication auditor that voids the ring's remaining slots. Each key pays its fees and bond, no batch discount; a notary vouching for clones forfeits its seat. Cloning costs N bonds and N live runs; honest agents pay once.
